description: UFO arc part 1/3: the UFO beam appears in the forest after hours of 'misi dulu' (running gag), payoff first. Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-ufo1/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-ufo1.mp4): five pieces of the stream #5 hour files in output order (windah-live5/stream-2216-2316.mp4 = h4 t1667-1676, stream-1916-2016.mp4 = h1 t326-334, h4 t1031-1039, h4 t1520-1526, h4 t1679.5-1688), 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: A t 1667.90-1674.40 = local 0.90-7.40 -> output 0.00-6.50; B t 328.30-332.20 = local 11.30-15.20 -> output 6.50-10.40; C t 1032.90-1037.00 = local 18.90-23.00 -> output 10.40-14.50; D t 1521.25-1524.50 = local 26.25-29.50 -> output 14.50-17.75; E t 1681.00-1687.60 = local 32.50-39.10 -> output 17.75-24.35. Beats: opens on the payoff (22:43 WIB, h4 27:48): glow behind the trees, the beam, Windah's in-game phone camera, photo mode; then the running gag in three short rewinds: h1 5:28 'misteri UFO di akhiran, kita misi-misi dulu lah' (chat spammed UFO from the start), h4 17:13 'harus malem kalau UFO? yaudah google aja deh', h4 25:21 '12 AM, ideal buat ketemu misteri UFO itu?'; back to the UFO with the photo-mode zoom on the disc and a figure in the beam (h4 28:01-28:07.6). Windah says nothing in the beam shots (short VAD runs of faster-whisper medium found no speech in h4 27:44-28:08); the hour transcripts' 'Aduh, apaan ini?' lines are not there, so no caption is claimed for them. CUT: h4 28:08.3-28:09.4 'Hey, what the f...' (swear, found by VAD at 1688.3-1689.4); the 26:20 swear and the 28:40 in-game subtitle swear are outside the cuts; Lucia's bra top and shirtless Jason (h4 24:00-24:50, 31:50+) are not used. Frames: forest, silhouette, phone, photo mode, two maps, Lucia running with a box; no guns, no gore, no drugs. Main 24.35 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1504x846 at (0,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 440x330 at (1480,538) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'AKHIRNYA UFO MUNCUL', line 2 Volt 'SETELAH MISI-MISI DULU', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
